name: 01.AI
short: Frontier lab behind the Yi series of bilingual MoE and coding models (Yi-Large, Yi-Large-Turbo, Yi-Large-FC, Yi-Vision), formerly offered through a first-party API platform billed per token. The open platform is being shut down: 01.AI announced 2026-08-10 it is winding down online experience, API calls, and top-ups to focus on enterprise AI; API service and model experience ended 2026-09-03, with account-balance refunds available through 2026-12-03 (platform notice).

plans.name: Free
plans.notes: Historical free tier of the open platform: $0 per 1M tokens, TPM 4, spending limit 32,000 tokens per the old pricing table. No longer live - the open platform terminated online experience and API service on 2026-09-03; new signups and top-ups stopped 2026-08-10; account-balance refunds open through 2026-12-03.

plans.name: Pay-as-you-go
plans.notes: Historical Yi model rates billed per million tokens via the 01.AI platform: yi-large $3/$3 per 1M input/output, yi-large-turbo $0.19/$0.19 per 1M input/output, yi-large-fc $3/$3 per 1M input/output, yi-vision $3/$3 per 1M input/output. Service discontinued 2026-09-03; balances refundable through 2026-12-03.
